research.title: Probability Calibration Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling and isotonic regression under controlled covariate shifts, separating calibration effects from changes in classification accuracy.
Analyzed reliability diagrams and bootstrap uncertainty estimates to assess how calibration performance depended on validation sample composition.

research.title: Covariance Shrinkage for High-Dimensional Classification
bullets: Designed simulation experiments comparing empirical and shrinkage covariance estimators within discriminant classifiers across correlated feature distributions.
Analyzed classification error and covariance estimation stability as feature dependence, sample availability, and departures from Gaussian assumptions varied.

research.title: Conformal Prediction Under Heteroskedastic Noise
bullets: Designed experiments comparing residual-based and quantile-based conformal prediction intervals on synthetic regression tasks with input-dependent noise.
Analyzed marginal coverage, subgroup coverage, and interval width to characterize uncertainty estimation tradeoffs across noise patterns and calibration splits.

publications.title: Coverage and Width Tradeoffs in Conformal Regression with Input-Dependent Noise

work.title: Validation and Error Handling for Batch Data Imports
bullets: Implemented input validation and error handling for batch imports, checking required fields, duplicate records, and inconsistent data types.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and revised diagnostic messages to support investigation of failed imports.

projects.title: Missing-Data Strategies for Tabular Classification
bullets: Implemented median imputation and iterative imputation within classification pipelines, keeping preprocessing confined to training folds during cross-validation.
Compared predictive performance under random and feature-dependent missingness, examining sensitivity to imputation choice and missingness indicators.

projects.title: Sparse Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented coordinate descent for lasso and elastic net regression, checking convergence against reference implementations on standardized datasets.
Compared prediction error and coefficient selection stability across regularization settings using synthetic designs with correlated predictors.

projects.title: Kernel Approximation for Nonlinear Regression
bullets: Implemented random Fourier features and Nyström approximations for kernel ridge regression, using shared preprocessing and validation splits.
Compared predictive error, runtime, and memory requirements while varying approximation size and kernel bandwidth on nonlinear regression tasks.
